Official website

Open the college website

—
  1. Scan the QR code with your phone camera — it opens the official site straight away.
  2. Tap “Open in new tab” — works whenever this app is running in a full browser tab.
  3. Or copy the link and paste it into your browser — you will land on exactly this page.
Open in new tab ↗
This college asks browsers not to show its website inside another page — that is why you may see a “content is blocked” message. The QR code and “Open in new tab” always reach the real site.

Tip: open this app in a full browser tab (the live-preview link) and the website button will take you straight to the college site.
